sql.query: SELECT s.id,s.replyToAddress,s.archiveBccAddress,COALESCE(s.copyInitiatingUser,0) copyInitiatingUser,COALESCE(s.copyWorkflowOwner,0) copyWorkflowOwner,s.emailFooterHtml,COALESCE(s.rowVersion,1) rowVersion,:emailEnabled emailEnabled,:fromConfigured fromConfigured,:fromAddress environmentFromAddress,CAST(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='email.configure' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=t.id AND utr.isActive=1) AS UNSIGNED) canConfigure,CAST(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='email.send' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:sendUser AND utr.tenantId=t.id AND utr.isActive=1) AS UNSIGNED) canSend FROM tbl_tenants t LEFT JOIN tbl_tenant_email_settings s ON s.tenantId=t.id WHERE t.id=:tenantId LIMIT 1
SELECT id,templateKey,templateName,subjectTemplate,isActive FROM tbl_contract_templates WHERE tenantId=:tenantId AND outputType='email' ORDER BY templateName
